# EliteFTS

> > EliteFTS is a leading strength training equipment manufacturer and education platform founded by Dave Tate, specializing in powerlifting gear, resistance bands, and evidence-based coaching resources.

Since 1998, EliteFTS has been outfitting athletes, coaches, and trainers with professional-grade strength equipment including monolifts, specialty bars, and resistance bands. The site combines an extensive product catalog with educational content covering powerlifting, strongman training, program design, and rehabilitation strategies.

## Programming & Periodization Guides

- [Block Periodization for Powerlifting](https://elitefts.com/blogs/motivation/a-practical-guide-for-implementing-block-periodization-for-powerlifting): Carlos Osegueda on block periodization: accumulation, transmutation, realization
- [Conjugate Sequential System Guide](https://elitefts.com/blogs/motivation/the-beginners-guide-to-the-conjugate-sequential-system): Beginner's guide to conjugate & concurrent training systems for powerlifting
- [Programming: Residual Effects & Compatibility](https://elitefts.com/blogs/motivation/the-coachs-guide-to-programming-and-periodization-residual-effects-compatibility-and-the-needs-analysis): Programming guide: residual effects, training compatibility & needs analysis
- [Programming: Basic Principles & Exercise Bank](https://elitefts.com/education/the-coachs-guide-to-programming-and-periodization-basic-principles-and-your-exercise-bank): Nick Showman on programming basics & building your exercise bank
- [Speed Work for Beginners](https://elitefts.com/blogs/motivation/beginners-guide-to-strength-training-to-speed-or-not-to-speed): Beginner's guide on speed work & dynamic effort method in strength training

- [One Arm Cable Pull Over](https://elitefts.com/education/exercise-index/one-arm-cable-pull-over): Exercise guide for shoulder mobility & lat flexibility by Dave Tate
